more_info.overview: Ethyl hydroxyethyl cellulose is a chemically modified cellulose ether containing both ethyl and hydroxyethyl groups. JECFA also names it as the 2-hydroxyethyl ether of ethyl cellulose. Its recorded food functions include emulsifying, thickening and stabilising. It is a polymer preparation rather than a small, single-formula molecule. This historical entry has its own identity within the modified-cellulose group.
